results.criterion: The page title and header show the name Brew Lab
results.note: <title>Brew Lab | Cafe in Indiranagar, Bengaluru</title>; header brand link reads 'Brew Lab'; h1 'Brew Lab'.

results.criterion: A menu section lists drinks, each with a price, and any price or item not supplied is a visibly marked placeholder
results.note: MENU has 5 entries with null name and price; each renders as a '.placeholder' span ('[Drink name n]', '[Price]') plus a menu-note. No invented prices or items.

results.criterion: The page states opening hours as 8am to 10pm, every day
results.note: '.hours-big' reads '8am to 10pm', 'Open every day'; all 7 day rows read '8am to 10pm'; the footer repeats it.

results.criterion: A location section names Indiranagar, Bengaluru and includes a map or map link, with the street address marked as a placeholder if not supplied
results.note: Section 'Find us' says 'Indiranagar, Bengaluru'; the Google Maps search link is present; '[Street address to be added]' and '[Phone number to be added]' are marked placeholders. The map box is a labelled placeholder, not a real pin.

results.criterion: A pre-order form lets a visitor choose menu items and quantities, enter a name and phone number, and pick a pickup time between 8am and 10pm, and shows an order summary on submit
results.note: Code read, not a run submit: qty steppers are built from BREWLAB_MENU; name, tel and time inputs (min 08:00, max 22:00) exist; validate() rejects mins < 480 or > 1320; showSummary() renders items, name, phone and time. The mechanical check found no JS errors.

results.criterion: The file has a viewport meta tag and mobile-first CSS (base styles for small screens, min-width media queries for larger ones)
results.note: Viewport meta present; base rules are unscoped; the only media queries are (min-width: 600px) and (min-width: 860px).

results.criterion: The CSS defines a warm colour palette and the layout has no fixed widths that force horizontal scrolling at 375px
results.note: :root defines cream, sand, espresso, caramel and terracotta. Mechanical check: overflow 0px at 360px and 1280px. No fixed widths over 360px (stepper input 3.2rem).

results.criterion: The site is one HTML file with inline CSS and JavaScript and needs no build step
results.note: One file of 25,526 bytes with 1 style block and 1 script. The only external reference is the Google Maps anchor href, not a loaded resource.

extra_issues.criterion: Charter open_inputs: order destination, real menu, address, phone
extra_issues.note: The summary says '[Order delivery to the cafe to be added]... not been sent to Brew Lab yet'. A visitor cannot place a real order until the Requester supplies a delivery channel and the real menu.
